name: Daisy
source:
The owner of the pharmacy. Her hobby is making and testing medicine, and she always makes suspicious magic potions. Although she speaks elegantly and politely, she is pretty sadistic. She is also one of the youngest witches in the village.

[From [url=https://www.kaguragames.com/product/the-hidden-village-of-witches-and-catgirls/]Kagura Games[/url]]
